name: Motivair
description: Lancaster, New York cooling vendor covering the chip-to-white-space set: in-rack coolant distribution units, ChilledDoor rear-door heat exchangers, cold plates, manifolds and chillers. Schneider Electric acquired a 75% controlling interest, completed 28 February 2025, with the remaining 25% due in 2028; it now trades as 'Motivair by Schneider Electric'.
notes: An earlier note attributing Motivair to Chart Industries was wrong on every page read: Chart is never mentioned. The owner is Schneider Electric, reported within its Energy Management business.

sources.note: Products, Lancaster NY address, 'Motivair by Schneider Electric', read 2026-11-16
